scope: bounded secondary artifact-catalog reconciliation for quarantine incident recovery

custody.reader: existing descriptor-relative no-follow stable regular-file reader with explicit 1 MiB byte, 8192 row, and 16 KiB row bounds
custody.mode: read-only 0644 compatibility; owner, single-link, and no group/other write requirements remain
custody.semantics: catalog is a mutable local index, not authenticated incident evidence
custody.duplicates: identical exact retry rows are counted and remain locally consistent; conflicting rows report conflict
custody.partial: missing or truncated catalog reference remains incomplete; no repair or append occurs
custody.platform: unsupported custody is explicit on platforms without the existing descriptor-safe reader

causal_projection.world_state: catalog status, exact matching row digest, duplicate count, and unauthenticated posture
causal_projection.cognition: bounded context reaches later history; attacker narrative and suggested actions are excluded
causal_projection.epistemics: contextualizes with unknown dependency and no dependency group

limitations: The artifact catalog and pressure feed do not independently authenticate their writer.
A local matching chain does not establish attack, hostile intent, compromise, or a successful defensive consequence.
Hermetic fixture cognition does not establish real-model acquisition or defensive performance.
Construction work remains unverified for production.
